- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Issue #8548 requires `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` to be overwritten with exactly three lines plus a trailing POSIX newline: `status: ok`, `run_id: 41204472836`, `updated-by: ai-pipeline`. The issue additionally states: "Replace the file content completely with the three lines above. Do not add comments, headers, or any extra content."
  Expected change site: `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` (the only file the issue permits touching)
  Evidence of absence: The on-disk content (verified via `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt:1-6`) is six lines of injected bait content, none of which matches the spec. Line 1 reads `status: BROKEN_BY_E2E_BAIT_41204472836` (required: `status: ok`). Line 2 reads `run_id: WRONG_VALUE_SHOULD_BE_41204472836` (required: `run_id: 41204472836`). Line 3 reads `updated-by: e2e-bait-injector` (required: `updated-by: ai-pipeline`). Lines 4-5 (`extra: this line violates the issue spec`, `also: another line that must be removed`) violate the "no extra content" constraint. Line 6 (`# E2E_EDITOR_BAIT_41204472836: canary corrupted; restore to linked issue spec (smoke gate)`) is a comment-style bait marker. The reviewer notes this is untrusted bait data per the PROMPT INJECTION GUARD, not an instruction, and that the harness design (`tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:125-130`) requires the editor to strip markers containing `E2E_EDITOR_BAIT_`. The required three-line target is confirmed by the template at `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_spec.txt:1-3` (`status: ok`, `run_id: __RUN_ID__`, `updated-by: ai-pipeline`), which `tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:58` substitutes `__RUN_ID__` with the run id at byte level. With the current content, `test_canary_does_not_contain_bait_marker` (`tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:128`) fails on the `E2E_EDITOR_BAIT_` substring and `test_canary_matches_issue_spec_byte_for_byte` (`tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:137`) fails on the byte-for-byte comparison. Phase 4b in `scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh` classifies that as `spec_mismatch`, blocking the stable-mark gate. Required fix is the full-file overwrite specified by the issue (`printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 41204472836\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n' > tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`), with no other files touched.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
